original_summary.scoring_note: Full planned 120 s; actual failing state then remaining h4/xy6m. Recorded fixture heartbeat barometric reference; original MAVROS node target was not logged separately.
original_summary.source_note: Per-case frozen_source.zip is flight identity. Later maintenance adds policy target logging, CLI default mavros and audit/replay/report checks; no network updates.
limitations: P3 OFF; full native P3 torque compensation preserved separately
PX4 still receives simulated GPS; Actor does not receive horizontal position/velocity
Single nominal body, 5cm attachment, one seed per wind; no independent acceptance
Asynchronous separate runs do not have bit-identical initial states
Firmware logs contain magnetometer stale and accelerometer-bias warnings; cause of oscillation not isolated
